title: Robustness and sensitivity check
description: Challenge a conclusion through independent tests, input removal, and a recommendation gate.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: robustness-sensitivity-check
  title: Robustness and sensitivity check
  description: Challenge a conclusion through independent tests, input removal, and a recommendation gate.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Determine whether a conclusion remains defensible under plausible alternative assumptions.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 5
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - recommendation-approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Conclusion, evidence, and assumptions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - conclusion
          - evidence
          - assumptions
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: tests
      kind: agent
      name: Independent robustness battery
      role: Sensitivity analyst
      prompt: Run independent methodological, data-quality, assumption, and counterexample checks. Return pass or fail per
        check with evidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: threshold
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Evaluate disagreement threshold
      role: Robustness evaluator
      prompt: Flag the conclusion when the configured number of checks disagree.
      config:
        threshold: 0.75
    - id: ablation
      kind: agent
      name: Input-removal analysis
      role: Independent analyst
      prompt: For every failed check, test whether the conclusion survives without the disputed input or assumption.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: recommend
      kind: agent
      name: Recommend conclusion status
      role: Decision analyst
      prompt: Recommend retain, qualify, revise, or reject. Cite robustness results and ablation findings.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: recommendation-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Sponsor approves recommendation
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Robustness report and recommendation
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: tests
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: tests
      to: threshold
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: threshold
      to: ablation
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e4
      from: threshold
      to: recommend
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e5
      from: ablation
      to: recommend
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: recommend
      to: recommendation-approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e7
      from: recommendation-approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
